description: Defines template classes for graphics buffer management, including LocalBufferType, SharedBufferType, ClientBufferType, and ServerBufferType, with methods for buffer handling, synchronization, and inter-process communication.

classes.name: LocalBufferType
classes.description: Template class managing local graphics buffers with iterator support.

classes.name: SharedBufferType
classes.description: Template class managing shared graphics buffers with inter-process synchronization.

classes.name: ClientBufferType
classes.description: Client-side implementation of shared buffer with request and event handling.

classes.name: ServerBufferType
classes.description: Server-side implementation of shared buffer with load and state management.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquire access to the buffer with locking, returning an iterator.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Request buffer state change (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: Published
methods.description: Notify buffer has been published (to be implemented by subclasses).
